'''Crissom''' was an officer in the [[Corellian Security Force]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. During [[Battle of Corellia|Corellia's war]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]], Crissom served alongside [[Hanley]], [[Davit]], and [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Silas (CorSec)|Silas]] in attacking Imperial forces that have taken the [[Corellian Security Force Academy]] in [[Axial Park]]. They were soon rescued by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces before they were overrun by the Empire.
